mapper.select: SELECT s.station_id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, s.station_code AS stationCode, s.address, s.station_status AS stationStatus, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = '1' AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayIncome, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS todayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = '1' AND o.create_time >= CURDATE() THEN o.total_energy ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayEnergy, s.total_piles AS totalPiles, s.available_piles AS availablePiles FROM stad_charging_station s LEFT JOIN stad_charging_order o ON s.station_id = o.station_id WHERE s.merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name, s.station_code, s.address, s.station_status, s.total_piles, s.available_piles ORDER BY s.station_id DESC
